Overview

Black Blade (Captain) is a MythicalMythical. He is only obtainable by evolving Black Blade.

Evolving

Black Blade (Captain) can be evolved from Black Blade with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Black Blade
x1 Dark Katana
x40 Magic Stone
x15 Enchanted Magic Stone
x15 Cursed Magic Stone

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability:True Damage

Black Blade (Captain) has the ability to deal 10% True Damage on every attack and attack through shields on enemies. Black Blade (Captain) deals full damage through shields and also damages shields after Upgrade 7.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
